title: Juniper and the Landfall
author: Wren Thackeray
blurb: Sebastian Oyelaran, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides before the concession permits expire.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
